_comment: Defense Reaction. 'The next card you play this turn with an effect that deals arcane damage instead deals that much +2' is exactly the engine's Amp mechanic (CR 8.5.47: next arcane damage this turn +N). Modeled as AMP 2. Prior JSON used a DEFEND-injected ON_PLAY trigger with MODIFY_ATTACK (which buffs attack power, not arcane damage).
